agentsSettings.title: AI agents
agentsSettings.intro: Let an AI agent (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and others) use Nemora: answer about your music and statistics, play, build queues and playlists. It connects through nemora-mcp, a small program beside Nemora; nothing is opened to the network. What it reads goes to the agent's own provider.

levelHint.off: Agents can do nothing in Nemora, not even read the library.
levelHint.read: Agents see what plays and the queue, but change nothing.
levelHint.control: Agents play, build the queue, make and edit playlists, set favourites, versions and lyrics. Your music files are never changed.
levelHint.full: Also your music files: tag edits (shown as a dry run first) and moving songs to the recycle bin, each only after you agree.

agentsSettings.connectHint: Add this command to an agent as an MCP server (stdio), or set it up below.
agentsSettings.setupHint: Setting up adds one entry, nemora, to that agent's config and keeps a backup of the file beside it. Restart the agent afterwards.
agentsSettings.noServer: nemora-mcp.exe comes with the installed Nemora; this build has none beside it.
agentsSettings.noLog: No agent has changed anything yet.

privacySettings.title: Privacy and your data
privacySettings.intro: Nemora is a player for the music on your computer. It needs no account and keeps your library, statistics and settings here. This is everything it sends anywhere, and when.

updates.name: Update check
updates.what: GitHub, a few seconds after each start. Nothing but the request itself; an update installs only when you agree.

lyrics.name: Lyrics
lyrics.what: LRCLIB, when the lyrics page shows a song with no lyrics of its own: its title, artist, album and length. The found lyrics are kept, so a song is looked up once.

pages.name: Album, artist and song pages
pages.what: Last.fm and Deezer, when you open such a page: the album, artist or song name, for its description, the artist's pictures and similar tracks.

tagSearch.name: Tag editor search
tagSearch.what: iTunes, Deezer and Last.fm, when you search for a song's tags: what you search for.

translation.name: Lyrics translation
translation.what: Google Translate, when you translate lyrics: their lines.

autoEq.name: Headphone correction
autoEq.what: The AutoEQ list on GitHub, when you look for your headphones: nothing but the request.

agents.name: AI agents
agents.what: Only when you connect one (Settings, AI agents): what it reads of your library and listening goes to that agent's own provider. Nemora itself sends nothing.

spotify.name: Import from Spotify
spotify.what: Spotify, when you import a playlist: its link, nothing else. Its tracks are found in your library on this computer.

nothingCounted.name: No tracking
nothingCounted.what: No analytics, no telemetry, no account. What you play, skip and rate is counted only here, for your statistics and Smart Shuffle.

discord.name: Discord status
discord.what: On unless you turn it off in Accounts: the song you play goes to the Discord app on this computer, which shows it to your friends.

obs.name: OBS widget
obs.what: Off unless you turn it on: served to this computer only, never to the network.

profile.name: Library and settings
profile.what: In your profile folder (%APPDATA%\Nemora): the library, statistics, playlists, settings and covers. Logs are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.cmrdevs.nemora\logs.

tagEditor.name: Tag editor
tagEditor.what: Writes a song's tags when you save them. The audio is never touched, so the song keeps its statistics.

switchVersion.name: Switch version
switchVersion.what: Writes its own field into the song's tag, so the sound comes with the file. Nothing else in the file changes; turn it off in Audio playback.

delete.name: Deleting a song
delete.what: Moves the file to the recycle bin, or deletes it for good only when you choose that.

chosen.name: Files you save
chosen.what: Versions, playlists and artwork you save go only where you choose.

lyricsEditorHelpPrompt.title: How to use Nemora's lyrics editor
lyricsEditorHelpPrompt.subTitle1: How to start using the editor?
lyricsEditorHelpPrompt.subTitle1Message:
1. Play the song that you are trying to edit lyrics of. (If you are not in the correct song, app will prevent adding incorrect metadata to lyrics lines.)
  2. Click on the page area to get focus to the page. (Page focus is required for the page-specific keyboard shortcuts to work.)
  3. Start the song from the begining. If you want more control over the playback, set to repeat the current song.
  4. When the voice of the song is saying the lyrics line, press $t(appShortcutsPrompt.enterKey) to highlight the next lyrics line and add the current time to start tag.
  5. Continue until the last lyrics line.
lyricsEditorHelpPrompt.subTitle2: What are the keyboard shortcuts I can use in the Lyrics Editor?
lyricsEditorHelpPrompt.subTitle2Message: Go to the <Button>Shortcuts Prompt</Button> to see the relevant shortcuts that can be used in the Lyrics Editor.
lyricsEditorHelpPrompt.subTitle3Message:
1. Pause the song.
  2. Locate the relevant lyrics line.
  3. Click the Edit button below that line and make the necessary modifications.
  4. After the modifications, click $t(lyricsEditingPage.finishEditing) to complete the modifications.

noraImportPrompt.title: Import from Nora
noraImportPrompt.message: This copies your entire Nora profile (songs, playlists, listening history, statistics, settings and artwork) into Nemora, replacing everything Nemora currently holds.
noraImportPrompt.backupNote: Nothing in Nora is modified or deleted, and Nemora's current profile is backed up first.
noraImportPrompt.importing: Importing. Copying artwork can take a while, so please leave the app open.
noraImportPrompt.imported: Imported {{songs}} songs, {{playlists}} playlists, {{listens}} listening records and {{artworks}} artwork files.
noraImportPrompt.restartRequired: Nemora must restart to load the imported profile.
noraImportPrompt.failedUntouched: Nothing was changed. Your Nemora profile is exactly as it was.
noraImportPrompt.failedAfterBackup: Your previous Nemora profile was backed up to {{path}} before the import began.

parts.confidence: How well Smart Shuffle knows it

smartShuffle.onlyUnheard: Only songs not heard for 30 days
smartShuffle.onlyRanked: Only songs ranked in a tierlist
smartShuffle.boostNew: Boost songs added in the last 14 days
smartShuffle.steeringApplied: Smart Shuffle steered; the songs after this one are reordered.
smartShuffle.settingsDescription: How Smart Shuffle explains itself and what you can steer. Only while Smart Shuffle is on.
smartShuffle.showReasons: Show why a song comes next
smartShuffle.showReasonsDescription: A short reason in Up next and the queue, and "Why this song?" in the player menu.
smartShuffle.steeringActionsDescription: Less of an artist, More like this and Not now in song menus, for this session.
smartShuffle.skipAwareDescription: A song you skipped early several times within two weeks, in different sessions, comes up half as often for a while.
smartShuffle.skipContext: Skips count only while you are really listening, not while you flick through your library.
smartShuffle.skipContextCount: Last 7 days: {{counted}} skips counted, {{ignored}} ignored as browsing
smartShuffle.sessionFiltersDescription: Filters in the queue that hold back songs heard lately or unranked, or boost new ones.
smartShuffle.tasteMapDescription: A map of your library in the sidebar and in Stats, drawn from how you listen.
smartShuffle.classicDescription: Turns every new part off: Smart Shuffle as it was in 3.0.
smartShuffle.recommendedDescription: The new parts on, the experimental ones off.
smartShuffle.learnDescription: Songs you pick yourself, replay or rewind to a moment come up more; songs you scrub through and skip come up less.
smartShuffle.adaptiveDescription: Starts from the classic score and trusts each signal more as it grows, giving songs it knows little about an occasional chance.
smartShuffle.implicitDuelsDescription: Skipping a song and picking another counts as a faint vote for the one you picked. Your duel ratings are never touched.
smartShuffle.freshnessByDaysDescription: A song heard yesterday waits longer than one heard last week, instead of counting the last 50 songs.
smartShuffle.fairRotationDescription: Every song of a tier gets its turn, not the same few.
smartShuffle.forgottenFavouritesDescription: Songs you love but have not heard for a long time, or did not recognise in Song Guessr, come up more.
smartShuffle.artistFatigueDescription: After several songs by one artist tonight, the next ones wait a little.
smartShuffle.favouriteMoments: Favourite moments on the seek bar
smartShuffle.favouriteMomentsDescription: Small marks where you keep coming back to in a song.
smartShuffle.nightDescription: Leans to what you play at this time of day.
smartShuffle.energyFlowDescription: Avoids jarring jumps in loudness and brightness, from the sound of each song. Analyses the library once in the background.
smartShuffle.followMapDescription: The next song leans to the ones near the current one on the taste map.
smartShuffle.teachingDuelsDescription: Some duels pick songs Smart Shuffle is least sure about, so each answer helps it most.

lyricsLibrary.label: Fetch lyrics for my library
lyricsLibrary.description: Finds lyrics for every song in the background, one a second, synced ones preferred. Lyrics next to your files or in their tags come first; your own edits are never replaced. This sends each song's title, artist, album and length to LRCLIB (lrclib.net).

correction.title: Headphone correction
correction.description: Evens out your headphones' frequency response with an AutoEQ profile, before the equalizer. The profile's own preamp lowers the level so its boosts cannot clip.
correction.listNote: Downloads the AutoEQ list (about 0.9 MB) from GitHub
correction.skipped_one: {{count}} line of the file is a filter type Nemora does not run and was left out
correction.skipped_other: {{count}} lines of the file are filter types Nemora does not run and were left out
correction.listFailed: Could not load the AutoEQ list: {{error}}
correction.unreadable: This file is not a ParametricEQ or Equalizer APO file: {{error}}
correction.credit: Profiles from AutoEQ by Jaakko Pasanen (github.com/jaakkopasanen/AutoEq), from measurements by their named sources. Nemora does not ship them; the one you pick is downloaded.

tasteMap.howTo: Scroll to zoom, drag to move, right-click a song for more.

tasteMap.legendCover: Dots take their cover's colour; bigger dots are songs Smart Shuffle favours now.
tasteMap.legendIsland: Each island is a group of songs you hear together, or that share artists or tiers.

tasteMap.legendTier: Warm: your top tiers. Cool: lower tiers. Faint: in no tierlist.

tasteMap.legendEnergy: Red: energetic. Blue: calm. Faint: not analysed yet (Settings, Energy flow).
